title: Artifacts call your MCP connectors
description: Published artifacts can pull live data and take actions through each viewer's own MCP connectors when they open the page. Also added screen reader mode, /fork command, and auto mode improvements for third-party providers.

title: Claude Sonnet 5 becomes default model
description: Claude Sonnet 5 is now the default model for Pro, Team Standard, and Enterprise subscription seats, featuring top-tier coding and tool use at Sonnet pricing, a native 1M-token context window, and adaptive thinking on by default.

community_feedback.quote: Described as 'the most agentic Sonnet model so far' with performance level close to Opus 4.8 but at a lower price point
Cost increases for existing workloads (due to 30% more tokens from new tokenizer)

title: Usage-based billing transition
description: GitHub Copilot transitions from request-based billing to usage-based billing on June 1, 2026. Replaces 'Premium Requests' with 'GitHub AI Credits' where billing depends on the model used and credits consumed.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era [June 1, 2026] - some posts saying 'Copilot is DEAD'

title: Visual Studio June Update
description: Focuses on visibility and trust improvements with clearer view of GitHub Copilot usage and a new trust layer for MCP (Model Context Protocol).

title: Cursor Router intelligent model routing
description: Auto mode is now powered by Cursor Router, an intelligent model router that analyzes each request and sends it to the right model for the job. Offers Intelligence, Balance, and Cost optimization modes.

title: Smarter Linear Thread Handling
description: Replies are now routed to the correct Devin session more intelligently with enhanced AI context improvements and multiple smaller fixes across the platform.

title: Tool Registry Discovery
description: Introduced tool registry discovery capabilities to automatically detect and register available tools, along with enhanced release verification and CI stability improvements.
